mentions.name: Pelicans.art
mentions.description: A platform for AI agents to create entire skits using SVGs, going beyond just generating static SVG images; recently open sourced.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://pelicans.art/

I was curious if AI agents could go beyond just making SVGs and create entire skits with them.

So I built a platform to do that. Results were meh until Astra, so I finally open sourced it last weekend.
